header.title: FAQs
header.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
header.description: Here are some common questions about my services to help you better understand how I work.

delivery.question: What is the delivery time for a project?
delivery.answer: The timeline depends on the complexity of the project. A showcase website can be delivered within 1 to 3 weeks, while a complete web or mobile application may require 3 to 7 weeks. A detailed schedule is defined after analyzing your requirements.

fullstack.question: Do you work on both front-end and back-end?
fullstack.answer: Yes, I am a full-stack developer. I build modern and optimized front-end interfaces and develop secure, robust APIs with NestJS on the back-end.

process.question: How does a project work with you?
process.answer: I start by analyzing your needs to propose the best solution. Then I go through design, development, testing, optimization, and finally deployment.

responsive.question: Do you build responsive applications?
responsive.answer: Yes, every application I develop is designed to work perfectly on desktop, tablet, and mobile devices, ensuring a smooth and consistent user experience.

refactor.question: Can you improve or redesign an existing application?
refactor.answer: Yes, I can optimize, modernize, or restructure an existing application to improve its performance, design, and maintainability.

contact.question: How can I contact you for a project?
contact.answer: You can contact me through the portfolio contact form or by email. I respond quickly to discuss your project and objectives.
